podcast.body: The Runaways recorded a live album in Japan in 1977, capitalizing on their immense popularity in the country where they were a significant sensation, unlike their career trajectory in North America. "In 1977, they even made a live album over there."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This live album was recorded in 1977 during The Runaways' tour of Japan, where they achieved significant sensation and success. "In 1977, they even made a live album."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
